metadata.title: Data and code for Valuing staged research portfolios for wildfire prevention
metadata.description: Reproducibility supplement for the economics of staged wildfire prevention research portfolios. Includes the archived FEMA National Risk Index version 1.20.0 county building-value expected annual loss extract and source provenance; a single implementation of adoption-dependent deployment costs, staged research portfolios, correlated outcomes, inverse effectiveness and commissioning-cost targets, conditional research-budget ceilings, and a separate information-value example; numerical outputs; seven manuscript tables; and four figures. Deployment and scientific inputs are illustrative scenarios, not empirical estimates of plant technology performance. FEMA source materials retain their source terms.
